description: This file is part of Twig, a templating engine for PHP. It defines the core class 'Parser' responsible for parsing Twig template tokens into an abstract syntax tree (AST) structure, handling template constructs, blocks, macros, and expression parsing.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Core class for parsing Twig template tokens into an AST, managing scope, blocks, macros, inheritance, and expression parsing.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method that parses a token stream into a ModuleNode representing the template's AST.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the environment object associated with this parser.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Generates a unique variable name for internal use during parsing.

methods.name: getBlockStack
methods.description: Returns the current stack of block names.

methods.name: peekBlockStack
methods.description: Returns the current top block name without removing it.

methods.name: popBlockStack
methods.description: Removes the top block name from the block stack.

methods.name: pushBlockStack
methods.description: Adds a block name to the block stack.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block with a given name exists.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Retrieves a block node by name.

methods.name: setBlock
methods.description: Defines a block node with a given name.

methods.name: hasMacro
methods.description: Checks if a macro with a given name exists.

methods.name: setMacro
methods.description: Defines a macro node with a given name.

methods.name: addTrait
methods.description: Includes a trait into the current template context.

methods.name: hasTraits
methods.description: Checks if there are any traits included.

methods.name: embedTemplate
methods.description: Embeds a sub-template into the current template context.

methods.name: addImportedSymbol
methods.description: Adds an imported symbol (variable, macro, etc.) to the current scope.

methods.name: getImportedSymbol
methods.description: Retrieves an imported symbol by type and alias.

methods.name: isMainScope
methods.description: Checks if the parser is in the main/global scope.

methods.name: pushLocalScope
methods.description: Creates a new local scope for imported symbols.

methods.name: popLocalScope
methods.description: Removes the current local scope.

methods.name: getExpressionParser
methods.description: Returns the expression parser instance.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node being extended, if any.

methods.name: hasInheritance
methods.description: Checks if the template has inheritance or traits.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent node for inheritance.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the current token stream.

methods.name: getCurrentToken
methods.description: Returns the current token in the stream.

methods.name: filterBodyNodes
methods.description: Validates and filters the body nodes of the template to ensure correct template structure.
